import re

def normalize(s):
    s = s.lower().strip()
    # remove extra punctuation
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s-]', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s

req_map = {normalize(name): qty for qty, name in requested}

cart_map = {}
for ci in cart_items:
    cart_map[normalize(ci['product_name'])] = cart_map.get(normalize(ci['product_name']), 0) + ci['quantity']

# Because normalization may differ, do a softer match by checking substring containment
